cases.name: trigger-watch-named-agent
cases.prompt: Diana's running that ticket with two helpers. Keep an eye on it and tell me when something happens.
cases.description: The plain request this skill exists for
assertions: Agrees the report triggers and a stop condition BEFORE the first round
Does not message Diana or her helpers

cases.name: trigger-tell-me-when-done
cases.prompt: let me know when the helper finishes, I don't want to sit and watch the pane
cases.description: Monitoring asked for as a single trigger rather than a running commentary
assertions: Skill activates and treats 'helper finishes' as the only trigger
Quiet rounds report one line, not a summary

cases.name: trigger-what-is-that-terminal-doing
cases.prompt: what has Nadia been doing for the last half hour?
cases.description: A one-off read of another agent's run — the same mechanism, one round
assertions: Reads the transcript rather than messaging Nadia
Does not set up a loop for a one-off question

cases.name: no-trigger-ask-the-agent
cases.prompt: ask Diana whether she's merged that branch yet
cases.description: An explicit instruction to MESSAGE another agent. That is send_message, and it is the one thing a monitor never does — the skill must not capture it

cases.name: no-trigger-review-the-code
cases.prompt: review the changes on task/50414e39 and tell me if they're any good
cases.description: Reviewing is a judgement about code; monitoring is a report about a run. Different job (pipeline / code-reviewer)

cases.name: no-trigger-run-the-work-yourself
cases.prompt: take over that ticket and finish it
cases.description: Taking over is the opposite of monitoring: from then on the run is one the agent is changing
assertions: If the agent was monitoring, it says it has stopped before starting work

cases.name: behaviour-find-by-session-id
cases.prompt: keep watching Iris — she just moved into a different worktree
cases.description: The transcript's DIRECTORY is derived from the agent's working directory, so it moves with a worktree switch while the session id does not
assertions: Re-resolves the transcript by session id rather than a remembered path
Does not report 'no change' merely because the old path went quiet

cases.name: behaviour-report-evidence-not-claims
cases.prompt: she says the branch is merged and pushed — is it?
cases.description: A 'done' message is a claim; the branch and the remote are the evidence
assertions: Checks git (log / branch --merged / remote) rather than quoting the agent's summary
States plainly which parts were verified and which were not
